title: Wind, slope, and the want of a tail: a computational feasibility study of Eilmer of Malmesbury's flight
description: Analysis code, LaTeX manuscript and figure render pipeline for a feasibility study of the eleventh-century flight of Eilmer of Malmesbury. The pipeline reconstructs the launch terrain, builds a wind climatology from ERA5 reanalysis, estimates ridge lift, integrates a standing-launch glide on two flight tracks, analyses pitch stability, runs a Monte Carlo over the unknown apparatus and launch day, and models the impact on the legs. Version 1.1.1 accompanies the revised manuscript: the text is shortened, every model number in the text is generated from the analysis outputs, and Figure 3 is re-rendered with Blender Cycles from the model geometry with the labelled 7 m2 wing area. Version 1.1.0 corrected the glide model of 1.0.0, which omitted the headwind from the ground speed and assumed the craft started at gliding speed; its results supersede those of 1.0.0.
